_note: New actor, first pricing entry. Market (2026-10-08): apify/screenshot-url (1,195 monthly users, 3.9 stars, pay for compute only), cheapapi/website-screenshot-api (106), i-scraper/website-screenshot $0.006 per result (46). Measured on platform at 4 GB: above the fold $0.0006 per capture (12 sites), full page $0.0026 (10 heavy sites incl. bbc, stripe, github). So two events: $0.003 viewport or element, $0.005 full page or PDF. Failed loads and 4xx/5xx pages free. No start fee, no proxy.

screenshot.eventDescription: One image (PNG, JPEG or WebP) of what fits in the viewport, or of a single element, for one URL on one device, stored with a public link. Pages that fail to load or answer 4xx/5xx are not charged.

full_page_screenshot.eventDescription: One image of the whole scrollable page (up to Max page height), or a PDF, for one URL on one device, stored with a public link. Pages that fail to load or answer 4xx/5xx are not charged.
